notes: Corrected: the supplied with of 'did lade you with a heavy yoke' moved from the noun עֹל to the verb העמיס. עֹל is the verb's direct object in the Hebrew, so rule 33's direct-object deferral sends the preposition to rule 44's supplied-preposition clause; the a stays with the noun under rule 15.
Italic 'will chastise you' read as the gapped second realization of יסר and its object suffix under rules 34/25 rather than added.
